metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Layer menu, clicked New Layer..., cleared the default name and typed 'Square', then clicked OK. GIMP showed 2 layers: 'Square' (transparent) and the background layer.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP Layer menu, open New Layer dialog, enter layer name, and confirm with OK.
metadata.task_rationale: Verifies the exact same goal as the successful trajectory. The evaluator reads the saved XCF file and checks that a layer named 'Square' exists.
metadata.explanation: Agent must use Layer > New Layer, type 'Square' as the layer name, confirm, then save with Ctrl+S. Postconfig sends Ctrl+S before evaluation. Getter parses the XCF binary to extract layer names; metric checks 'Square' is present. Negative control: initial XCF has only the background layer, so the test passes only after adding 'Square'. llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the XCF file from the VM and parses layer names from the binary format, extracting exactly the state needed to verify the instruction.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('layer_name', '') directly from the rules dict (correct for type='rule'), and checks membership in layer_names.
Postconfig sends Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the saved file state is read.
Negative control resistance is intact: initial XCF has only the background layer, so the initial state will not pass.
Both sub-goals (add layer named 'Square' + save file) are covered by the evaluator.
XCF binary parser handles version differences (v11+ 64-bit offsets vs 4-byte offsets) and has proper error handling.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The XCF binary parser is a custom implementation; if GIMP saves XCF with unusual property structures, parsing might fail, but error handling gracefully returns empty layer_names in that case.
